projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: My portfolio website showcasing my projects, skills, and experience. Built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, featuring a clean and modern design and a responsive layout that works seamlessly across all devices. Uses a modular, JSON-driven architecture where all content is defined in JSON files and dynamically rendered, making adding a new project or updating the timeline as simple as editing a JSON file without touching any HTML or CSS.

projects.title: NxN Systolic Array
projects.description: NxN systolic array accelerator for chained matrix-matrix multiplication designed in Verilog. A systolic array is a specialized hardware accelerator for matrix-matrix multiplication. My implementation arranges N×N processing elements (PEs) in a grid, each performing fixed-point 16-bit multiply-accumulate operations. What makes it systolic is the way inputs and outputs propagate through the array, ensuring that data arrives at each PE at precisely the right time for multiplication and results flow out from each PE to be accumulated. The finite state machine controls instruction decoding, data feeding, matrix tiling/chaining, and result draining. This implementation is based on Coding Test 4 in the specification from the Efficient and Intelligent Computing Lab at Georgia Tech.

projects.title: RepoRuler
projects.description: Chrome extension that displays GitHub repository size in the About section next to forks and stars. I created this because one time I accidentally cloned a repo that was 40GB. The extension works for public repos automatically, and private repos can use a Personal Access Token (PAT) for authentication. It helps developers quickly see repository sizes before cloning.

projects.title: AnySpeed
projects.description: Chrome extension that provides enhanced video playback speed controls. This extension allows users to have more granular control over video playback speeds, making it easier to watch content at custom speeds that suit individual preferences. Built to improve the video watching experience with flexible speed options.
